scientific_integrity: Self-contained analytic arguments are distinguished from finite exact diagnostics. Prior model and marginal Bernoulli representation are credited. No independent validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: First-order almost-sure laws only. Does not cover root degrees, zero mass values, nonregular tails, second-order extreme-value fluctuations, or dependent attachment mechanisms. Historical priority has not been independently established.
scientific_scope: Positive-vertex offspring maxima in the one-choice iid subtractive random forest with strictly positive attachment-lag masses. Two alternative tail regimes: stretched exponential and summable polynomial.
title: Sharp maximum-offspring laws for subtractive random forests
